TechOnBUILT – The Digital Transition in Construction podcast

Episode 2 – BIM, much more than a buzzword.

Building Information Modeling is an advanced way of working that helps architects, engineers and construction professionals in the planning, design, construction and management of infrastructure development and construction. This way of working integrates the five main aspects of a project to ensure maximum effectiveness throughout the whole process: Information, Technology, People, Processes and Policies. Contrary to what some people think, BIM is not an application or software for producing 3D models of infrastructure, but rather a methodology for working with 3D, 4D, 5D and even 6D models: time, costs, operations, among other things. Whether or not to use BIM will very soon stop being an option and become a necessity.
In this second episode we were joined by Miguel Pires, Technical Director of Grupo Casais, who talked to us about the use of BIM methodologies, in a "conversation" led by António Aguiar Costa, Research and Development Director at BUILT CoLAB.

You can also listen to this Podcast on Apple and PodBean.
